name: Professor Plum
biography: Professor Plum is an experienced reverse engineer, developer, and digital forensics examiner. He holds a graduate degree in Information Security from Johns Hopkins University, and has worked numerous computer incident investigations spanning the globe. He currently works as a Senior Threat Researcher for a Fortune 500 cybersecurity company and previously worked for the Department of Defense performing vulnerability research, software development, and Computer Network Operations. @professor__plum
